# Taher Jamali

> Software Engineer — Machine Learning & Platform Security

## Summary

I turn manual pentesting into systems that watch themselves. I build AI agents and security automation that hold up in production, not just in demos. My flagship project is an autonomous multi-agent system that pentests cloud applications end-to-end — but the thread through most of my work is the same: find the manual, error-prone process and replace it with a system that runs itself, catches its own failures loudly, and scales past the point a human could keep up.

## Current Role

Software Engineer — Platform Security, Infrastructure & AI/ML, on the enterprise cloud platform team of a Fortune 500 technology company (2024–present). Highlights:

- Designed and built an autonomous multi-agent AI penetration-testing system (Python, Claude, Gemini) that discovers and tests production applications end-to-end — blackbox and whitebox — reaching 95% single-pass accuracy on a 24-case benchmark.
- Root-caused a production bug causing up to 68x redundant scheduled work per application; replaced compensating retry logic with a durable, structurally-enforced queue that eliminated the failure class.
- Designed and shipped a full-stack operator dashboard (React, Express, SQLite) replacing CLI-only tooling for a fleet-wide security scanning platform covering 100+ internal applications.
- Built a source-code-aware AI scanning pipeline that re-verifies its own findings against live traffic before surfacing them, cutting false-positive security alerts.
- Automated disaster-recovery failover across two AWS regions (DNS/GSLB-based), including a standalone desktop app so on-call engineers can execute failover without CLI access mid-outage.

## Prior Experience

**Data Scientist, Chirality Research Inc** (Nov 2022 – Aug 2023) — Developed end-to-end ML solutions (data preprocessing, feature engineering, model training and evaluation), reducing operational downtime by 20%. Automated reporting workflows, improving team productivity by 15%.

## Featured Project

**LangChain RAG Agent** — A web-based Q&A chatbot with a full RAG pipeline: automated web-content ingestion, query-quality evaluation, document relevance grading, and query rewriting, orchestrated as a LangGraph state machine with persistent conversation memory. Stack: Python, FastAPI, LangChain, LangGraph, React.

- **Full-Stack & Platform:** React, REST APIs (Express, FastAPI), real-time streaming (SSE), SQLite, AWS, Docker, dashboard/operator UX design
